what: Live Channel3 evidence for the SaySafe Assistant repair (branch assistant-repair). Real API (api.trychannel3.com) via the server, key injected on the wire, never logged. Recorded by a QA-only fetch wrapper (bodies + responses, no headers). Responses trimmed to 5 products each.
apiContractCheckedAgainst: https://api.trychannel3.com/openapi.json (SearchFilters: brand_ids, gender, age, price{min_price,max_price}, website_ids, colors{palette}[beta], …; SearchConfig: country, currency, language). Top-level locale is not sent.

liveCallBudget.note: 2 direct exploratory searches (filters check, colors.palette beta check), 6 in a first app run of which 3 were wasted by a refinement bug (fixed: a new product request is a new search, not a refinement of the last one), 3 in the final browser run (kettle, black women’s Nike T-shirts under €40, PS5).

colorsPaletteEvaluation.decision: Not used. A pure-black palette (default match "standard") returned 0 listings that plainly exist. Colour is ranked locally from listing text and Channel3’s measured photo colours, and a card says "Listed as black" or "Main colour in the photo looks black". It never claims more than that.

constraintsMet.kettle: Yes: every card is a kettle; IE/EUR offers only; real retailer links (currys.ie, currys.co.uk); prices as listed. The remembered sample colour and budget were applied only in ranking, with a line explaining it.
constraintsMet.blackWomensNikeUnder40: Yes for women’s, Nike and ≤ €40: Channel3 filters gender=female, age=adult, brand_ids=[Nike], max_price=40, and every card is ≤ €40 and Nike. Black was ranked locally; Channel3 does not guarantee colour.
constraintsMet.ps5: Partly, in the live run: 1 card (a PS5 controller), because the remembered sample budget of €150 filtered out every console (€599–€1,015). Fixed after this run: a remembered budget now narrows results only when at least 3 (or half) of the listings fit, and accessories rank after the main product. Re-checked on the RECORDED live response (tests/fixtures/channel3-ps5.json, mock replay): PlayStation 5 Digital Edition Console €599 at currys.ie comes first. No extra live call was spent on this. The gift recipient ("grandson") was never sent to Channel3.
